title: Fix login failure classification bug (disabled users mislogged)
description:
## Source
Audit swarm finding F-AG2-01 / F-001 (memorysmith-codebase-audit-26-07-11-03-39-33)

## Problem
`SignInAsync` computes `"disabled"` failure code in an unreachable branch; disabled users are logged as `"invalid_credentials"` instead of `"disabled"`. This corrupts audit trail and monitoring dashboards.

## Severity
High

## Files
- `MemorySmith.App/Services/MemorySmithLocalAuthService.cs`

## Recommendation
Fix branch logic: split flow into explicit states (not_found, disabled, invalid_credentials, success).

## Existing Coverage
No existing task.
